about: Every built-in tool a client offers the model, with the class that decides its guard. harness/run.py and harness/codex.py read the tool list of the real client from each request body and fail on a name that is not here; tests/test_invariant_store_reads.py (I3) reads the classes. Classes: reads-path and edits-path take a local path (the PreToolUse matcher must reach them and the store refuses them); shell is Bash; mcp-resource reads a resource by URI (a file: URI can name the store); no-path takes no local path, and `why` says so. MCP tools (mcp__*) are matched by their prefix and are not listed.

Edit.why: reads the file before it changes it; the result shows a piece of it

PowerShell.why: the shell tool on Windows without Git Bash (2.1.284): placeholders are refused, the store backstop applies

ReadMcpResourceTool.why: a filesystem server serves file: URIs

ReadMcpResourceDirTool.why: lists and reads resources under a URI

ListMcpResourcesTool.why: lists the resource names a server offers, no content

Agent.why: a subagent's own tool calls pass the same hooks

Workflow.why: the agents it starts pass the same hooks

SendMessage.why: a message to another agent or session

CronCreate.why: schedules a prompt, which passes the prompt hook when it runs

EnterWorktree.why: creates or enters a git worktree; reads no file content

Skill.why: loads a skill the user installed

SlashCommand.why: runs a command file the user installed

ReportFindings.why: reports review findings to the host UI

WaitForMcpServers.why: waits for MCP servers to connect

BashOutput.why: returns output of a Bash call the hooks saw; PostToolUse redacts it

exec.why: code mode: the nested tools.exec_command reaches the hooks as Bash

apply_patch.why: one patch whose headers name the paths; the matcher reaches it through its aliases Write and Edit (measured on 0.158.0, tests/client_payloads/codex-apply-patch.json)

spawn_agent.why: a subagent's own tool calls pass the same hooks

collaboration.why: the namespace of the agent tools

functions.why: the namespace of the function tools
